changelog: - **Whatever a user does on one product's site stays in that product** (SaleVali ↔ Internship CRM). Reported: "forgot password" on SaleVali sent an *Internship CRM* reset mail with an interncrm.com link — `findAccountsForMailedLink` used to fall back to the address's account in the other world (the documented "wrong-door rescue"). An audit of every output surface then confirmed 66 leaks of the same kind, fixed here: forgot/resend mail only accounts of the request host's world; mail sender name, subject, header, accent, List-Id and unsubscribe footer follow the recipient's org (default world byte-for-byte unchanged); announcements, targeted mail, newsletters, the deliverability test, meeting invites, guest invites/reminders, message mirrors and every scheduled digest/reminder carry the recipient's brand and origin; admin fan-outs (sign-up, mentor application, apply duplicate, mentorship/rematch/project-join requests, support) reach only the admins of the org the event belongs to, and the admin activity digest and weekly analytics report no longer mix tenants; notifications/digests for a capability the org does not have are skipped instead of re-branded; ICS feed, calendar name/PRODID, Google Calendar round-trip, 2FA issuer, web-push icon and Jitsi room names follow the account's world; sign-in no longer names or links the other product, register/SSO refuse an invitation token or org code of the other world like an unknown one; legal/trust/accessibility/AI pages, public profiles, the OpenAPI title, share target and release-notes feed wear the host's product. `outcomeAutoSend` is now read from the relation's own org. Docs: `docs/worlds.md`.

en: Everything you do on SaleVali now stays in SaleVali (and the same for Internship CRM): password-reset and verification e-mails, notifications, reminders, calendar entries and links always come from the product you are using.
tr: SaleVali'de yaptığın her şey artık SaleVali'de kalıyor (Internship CRM için de aynısı): şifre sıfırlama ve doğrulama e-postaları, bildirimler, hatırlatmalar, takvim kayıtları ve bağlantılar her zaman kullandığın üründen geliyor.
de: Alles, was du in SaleVali tust, bleibt jetzt in SaleVali (und genauso bei Internship CRM): Passwort-Reset- und Bestätigungsmails, Benachrichtigungen, Erinnerungen, Kalendereinträge und Links kommen immer aus dem Produkt, das du gerade nutzt.
